productBugs.summary: Re-typing a Contract requires a Field Row under a Branch whose condition does not hold. The create dialog and create API skip such a Row (DD-028); the Change contract type dialog and the PATCH seam both demand it.
productBugs.reproduction: Type DOC-032 contracts-2 Form type 1790582775732: required Deal size, then a Branch (Deal size greater than 100000) holding required Escalation reason. On an MSA Contract, choose that type on Overview, enter Deal size 42, select Change type. The dialog lists Escalation reason and refuses with "Fill DOC-032 contracts-2 Escalation reason 1790582775732 — the new type requires it.". PATCH /api/v1/contracts/535 with the same type and Deal size 42 answered 400 "Fill DOC-032 contracts-2 Escalation reason 1790582775732 first — the type requires it.". Creating a Contract of the same type with Deal size 5000 does not ask for or require Escalation reason.
productBugs.source: apps/web/src/routes/contract-record.tsx RetypeDialog uses unansweredRequired(target.fields) without evaluating the Form's Branches; the contract PATCH re-type check refuses the same way
productBugs.guideImpact: None found: the guide says only that Change contract type requests missing required Fields.

steps.action: Create the record, steps 1-5 and If a change is refused: dialog order, Default type first, Legal Owner seed and choices, archived type and Entity not offered, blank Title, missing type, blank required Rows, Branch Row, Cancel
steps.expected: Title, Contract type, Legal Owner, Matter, the Form's Rows, Confidential, Documents, Create; Default preselected; Legal Owner starts on the acting person with Unassigned and staff only; errors Name the contract., Pick a contract type., and named required Rows; a Branch reveals its Row only when its condition holds; nothing is created.
steps.actual: Dialog order: ["Title","Contract type","Legal Owner","Matter","Description","Counterparties","Needed by","Deal value (USD)","Confidential — restrict to the contract team","Documents","Cancel","Create"]. Contract type started on "Default"; the Default type's creation Rows were ["Description","Counterparties","Needed by","Deal value (USD)"]. Legal Owner started on "Nadia Haddad" and offered 31 entries: ["Unassigned","Daniel Okafor","Devon Calloway","Ines Duarte","Marcus Oyelaran","Nadia Haddad","Priya Raman","Sofia Lindqvist","Tom Iwu"] plus 22 staff accounts walkthrough agents created; no Business User and not archived Gabriel Santos. The archived fixture type was not in 23 type options. Blank Create said "Name the contract."; with a Title and "Type…" it said "Pick a contract type.". "DOC-032 contracts-2 Form type 1790582775732" drew ["Entity","Counterparties","DOC-032 contracts-2 Deal size 1790582775732"] and not the Branch Row or the record Rows; Entity offered 113 Entities without the archived fixture Entity. Blank Create said "Fill DOC-032 contracts-2 Deal size 1790582775732 — this contract type requires it."; "twelve" in the number Row said "DOC-032 contracts-2 Deal size 1790582775732: enter this as a number."; Deal size 5000 kept the Branch Row hidden and the server refusal named the blank built-in Rows: "Fill Our entity, Counterparties.". Deal size 250000 revealed "DOC-032 contracts-2 Escalation reason 1790582775732"; with Entity and Counterparties filled, Create said "Fill DOC-032 contracts-2 Escalation reason 1790582775732 — this contract type requires it.". Cancel closed the dialog and no Contract titled "DOC-032 contracts-2 legal_team_member refusal 1790582775732" exists.
